description: Toy Box Friends batch 3 models (pre-K to grade 5): life-cycle stages (frog, butterfly, bean), globe and sun lamp, body-systems models, maths and measuring tools, school and lab sets, nature and ecosystem critters, everyday and story props. Same part format as models.json.

tadpole.description: A round brown tadpole (frog life-cycle stage 2) with a sandy belly, big eyes and a long swishing tail (named "tail"); swims at about 0.4 m.

froglet.description: A young froglet (frog life-cycle stage 3): a small green frog with legs and a little tail stub (named "tail") it has not lost yet.

caterpillar.description: A friendly green caterpillar (butterfly life-cycle stage 2): five round body segments trailing to its right (-x), stubby feet, yellow dots and bobbly antennae; the head is at +x.

worm.description: A friendly pink earthworm: a wavy body of soft round segments along the ground to its right (-x) with a rosy band, rising to a smiling head at +x (0.95 m long).

hawk.description: A friendly toy hawk (a bird of prey) with a white head, big kind eyes, a little gold hooked beak, a cream chest, yellow feet, long folded wings (named "wing", mirrored) and a tail fan ("tail").

bug.description: A friendly ladybird bug: a shiny red spotted shell (named "shell") with a seam down the middle, a dark round head with big white eye patches and a smile, six little legs and bobbly antennae. 0.6 m long.

bee.description: A round, fuzzy-looking toy bumblebee standing upright: a yellow body with dark stripes, a yellow head with a smile, bobbly antennae and see-through wings (named "wing", mirrored) that buzz.

frog_eggs.description: Frog spawn (frog life-cycle stage 1): a jelly cluster of ten see-through eggs, each with a dark dot inside, 0.4 m across; float it on a pond.

chrysalis.description: A green chrysalis (butterfly life-cycle stage 3) with gold dots, hanging by a silk thread from a twig on a little branch stand; the chrysalis (named "chrysalis") sways from the thread's top.

bean_seed.description: One big bean seed (bean life-cycle stage 1), 0.24 m long, cream with a brown scar on top; the seed coat is named "coat". Lies on the ground.

bean_sprout.description: A sprouting bean (bean life-cycle stage 2) in a clear cup of soil, pressed to the front glass so you can see it: the split seed coat ("coat"), a white first root ("root") growing down, and a green hooked shoot ("shoot") just poking out of the soil. 0.44 m tall.

bean_plant.description: A young bean plant (bean life-cycle stage 3) in the same clear cup of soil: roots showing through the glass, a tall stem, heart-shaped leaves, a white flower and three green bean pods (each named "pod"). 0.95 m tall.

globe.description: A desk globe: a blue Earth with raised green and sandy continents and white ice caps on a tilted axis rod (named "axis", 23 degrees) over a red stand. The Earth (named "globe") spins about its tilted axis: tween <id>#globe rotation to [0, 0, 360] (rotation about z only; the tilt stays). 0.7 m tall.

sun_lamp.description: A sun lamp for day and night demos: a glowing golden sun-ball (named "sun") with a ring of short rays on a grey stand, its centre at globe height (0.42 m); 0.7 m tall. Put it beside the globe.

body_model.description: A see-through toy body model, 1.2 m tall on a blue stand, with a friendly face: inside the clear glass body sit the heart ("heart"), two lungs ("lungs", mirrored, so a position x offset moves them apart), the windpipe and its two branches ("windpipe"), and red and blue blood-vessel tubes ("arteries", "veins"). Each named part can be highlighted or moved out for an exploded view.

heart.description: A big rounded toy heart (the organ, cute and glossy) on a little stand, 0.72 m tall, built from four chambers that pull apart: "right_atrium", "right_ventricle" (pink, on the viewer's left) and "left_atrium", "left_ventricle" (red, on the viewer's right), plus the red "aorta" and blue "vena_cava" and "pulmonary_artery" tubes on top. Move a chamber with <id>#<name> position for an exploded view.

lungs.description: A pair of soft pink lungs on a little stand, 0.8 m tall, a little see-through so the branching airways show: the cream windpipe and its two branches ("windpipe") and the lungs with their inner branches ("lungs", mirrored: a position x offset moves them apart).

domino.description: A big domino standing on its short end, facing +z, 0.54 m tall: 3 pips on the top half and 4 on the bottom (7 in all). Each half and its pips are named ("top_half", "bottom_half") so they can light up or pull apart.

protractor.description: A yellow protractor standing up facing +z, 0.92 m wide: a half disc with a tick every 10 degrees (taller at 0, 30, 60... and tallest at 0, 90 and 180), a baseline and a red centre ring at (0, 0.08, 0). No numbers.

metre_stick.description: A 1 m metre stick standing on its long edge facing +z, made of ten coloured 10 cm bands (named "tenth_1" at -x to "tenth_10" at +x, for decimals and tenths), with tall ticks every 10 cm and short ticks at each 5 cm. Turn [-90, 0, 0] to lay it flat.

dollar_bill.description: A toy one-dollar note at the coins' scale (real size x10: 1.56 x 0.66 m), standing up facing +z: a pale green note with a darker green border, a "1" in each corner and a round toy portrait (a smiling cartoon face) in the middle; not real currency art. Turn [-90, 0, 0] to lay it flat.

pizza_slice.description: One slice of pizza lying flat, tip pointing +x, sandy crust at -x, cheese and three pepperoni (0.42 m long), to match the round pizza.

chalkboard.description: A standing classroom chalkboard, 1.5 m wide and 1.55 m tall, facing +z: a green board (named "board", front face at z 0.03) in a wooden frame on two legs, with a chalk tray holding white and yellow chalk and an eraser.

lab_bench.description: A school lab bench 1.6 m wide and 0.9 m high, facing +z: a white worktop, teal cupboards with mint doors and grey handles, a back upstand and a grey tap at the back.

beaker.description: A clear glass lab beaker, 0.3 m tall, with a pouring lip and white level lines, a third full of blue water (named "water"). Move <id>#water down a little to lower the level (scale cannot change; for a rising level use a separate water shape and grow it).

microscope.description: A toy school microscope seen side-on (profile in the x/y plane, eyepiece leaning to +x), 0.62 m tall: blue base and arm, white tube with a grey eyepiece and lens, a grey stage holding a glass slide, a yellow focus knob and a little glowing light under the stage.

test_tube_rack.description: A wooden rack (0.42 m wide) holding four glass test tubes with red, blue, green and yellow liquid; each tube and its liquid is named "tube_1" (-x) to "tube_4" (+x) so one can be lifted out.

notebook.description: Owl's spiral notebook, standing upright (0.36 m tall), cover facing +z: a blue cover with a white label and a gold star, silver rings along the left edge, lined pages inside. The cover (named "cover") hinges at the rings: turn <id>#cover to [0, -150, 0] to open it.

grass.description: A tuft of seven pointed grass blades in three greens, 0.36 m tall, swaying gently.

mushroom.description: A cheerful toadstool, 0.4 m tall: a cream stem and a red cap (named "cap") with white spots. Not for eating.

leaf_pile.description: A soft heap of autumn leaves, 0.9 m wide and 0.3 m high: an orange mound covered in red, yellow, gold, rose and brown leaves.

acorn.description: A glossy brown acorn (an oak seed), 0.22 m tall, with a sandy textured cap and a little stalk.

market_stall.description: A market stall 1.9 m wide and 2 m tall, facing +z: a wooden counter with a yellow front, red-and-white striped awning (named "awning") with a scalloped edge on four posts, and two crates of apples and oranges on the counter.

shelf.description: A wooden bookshelf 1 m wide and 1.2 m tall, facing +z, with three shelves: books on the bottom shelf, a teddy-sized space in the middle and a few more books on top (shelf tops at 0.06, 0.45 and 0.83 m).

socks.description: A matching pair of red socks with white cuffs, heels, toes and stripes, standing side by side with toes pointing +x (0.5 m wide); each sock is named ("left" at -x, "right" at +x) so the pair can be split or matched.

mittens.description: A pair of cosy blue mittens with white cuffs and a white heart, thumbs pointing in, standing up facing +z (0.5 m wide); named "left" (at -x) and "right" (at +x).

pattern_machine.description: A friendly pattern machine 1.3 m tall, facing +z: a purple box on feet with a smiling face on a sky-blue screen, a yellow input chute on top (named "input_chute") where things drop in, an orange output chute slide on its right (+x, named "output_chute") where they come out, a dial on the front (named "dial": turn about z) with three buttons, and a glowing antenna light ("light").

crown.description: A gold queen's crown, 0.3 m across and 0.24 m tall: a band with six points topped with gold and pearl balls, and red and blue jewels at the front. Sits on a head (put it on a character or critter head).

nest.description: A twiggy bird's nest 0.55 m across with three pale blue eggs inside (named "egg_1" to "egg_3").

hat.description: A sun hat, 0.46 m across and 0.18 m tall: a straw-coloured crown and wide brim with a red ribbon band and a little flower.

rug.description: A cosy rectangular rug lying flat, 1.6 x 1 m: a red edge, cream and blue bands, a yellow star in the middle and cream fringe at both ends (for sitting circles and stories).

jar.description: An empty clear glass jar, 0.34 m tall, with a red screw lid (named "lid", lift it off with a position offset) and a cream label with a star. Fill it with props for counting or estimation.

tent.description: A little camping tent 1.3 m wide, 1.05 m tall and 1.6 m deep, door facing +z: orange sides, a yellow door flap (named "door") over a dark doorway, a ridge pole and a little sandy mat at the door.

backpack.description: A school backpack 0.46 m tall, facing +z: blue body, a red front pocket, a top flap (named "flap"), a carry loop and two straps at the back.

lunchbox.description: A teal lunchbox 0.36 m wide with a yellow lid (named "lid", hinged at the back: turn <id>#lid to about [-100, 0, 0] to open it), a carry handle on the lid, a red latch and a star sticker.

water_bottle.description: A reusable teal water bottle, 0.32 m tall, with a white cap (named "cap"), a carry loop and a white band with a blue drop.
